definitions.explanation: A clock that can be set to make a sound at a specific time, typically used to wake someone up.

examples.japanese: {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: To turn off the alarm clock.

examples.japanese: {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{六時|ろくじ}→六時：10982_rokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I set the alarm clock for 6 o'clock.

examples.japanese: {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}っても→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦{起|お}きられなかった→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't wake up even when the alarm clock went off.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{目覚|めざ}まし→目覚まし：08550_mezamashi⟧ (awakening, alarm) + ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ (clock)

Note: The reading of {時計|とけい} changes to どけい through rendaku.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧/⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (set the alarm)
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ (turn off the alarm)
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ (alarm goes off)

ALTERNATIVE: Often shortened to ⟦アラーム→アラーム：10707_araamu⟧ (alarm) in modern usage, especially when referring to smartphone alarms.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ (clock, watch)
- ⟦アラーム→アラーム：10707_araamu⟧ (alarm)
- ⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (to wake up)
